game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled crystal shards but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled crystal shards but keep the loop running. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about skipped_ok to power up the cave miner and open the ore lift.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Hidden Spring'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Hidden Spring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
